Join: Molecule dictionary to compound records (compound_records) on molregno, then to documents (docs) on doc_id. Left join compound structures on molregno. Filter: Documents where chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1130277'. Sort: ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit: None.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1130277' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
